issues: Square-capped white bars on a flat grey background look like a debug pixel font, with no material and no light
Segments light at a constant 6f interval from start to finish, so the suspense never tightens or pauses
The word spans only half the frame with stiff block letterforms, and the reveal is just a 6% scale bump
A placeholder title with the card name sits in the corner, and the frame has no sense of space
changes: Look switched to aurora: a neon sign on a deep violet wall. SHIP is redrawn as a 400px monoline geometric word split into 16 tubes with electrode gaps (white-hot core, pink tube, near and far glow layers)
Each tube strikes on with a 7f neon stutter (on-off-on-half-on) and settles at 0.58 brightness during the suspense; on the reveal the whole sign powers up to full and surges once
Re-timed as sparse to dense (9f down to 3f intervals), a 14f held breath, three key tubes on three beats, then the reveal; the keys are the S spine, the H crossbar and the P bowl
Added space: wall light grows with the number of lit tubes, a lit band sits on the floor line, and a glossy floor reflects the lower half of the sign; a slow 1 to 1.035 push runs throughout
Removed the placeholder title; the subline "VERSION 4.0 * AVAILABLE TODAY" rises only after the reveal; duration 150 to 165f
